desc: The Hideout Belly Band Holster from Allen is an adjustable, breathable waist band for concealed carry that is designed to be used right- or left-handed, as well as cross-draw. This holster fits most conceal carry handguns, and the comfortable stretch fabric has ventilation throughout to keep you cool. The holster pocket features dual layers and an adjustable strap to secure your firearm. Also includes to magazine pockets.
